semiconductor_relevance: High — Haituo Instrument specializes in high-end simulation climate environment test equipment and semiconductor live test systems, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
summary: Haituo Instrument (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced testing equipment for the semiconductor industry, including environmental test chambers and thermal shock testing machines. The company serves a wide range of sectors, including semiconductor, automotive electronics, and telecommunications.
